name: Tutorial comments in every source file
body: List every .nox and .nyx file that lacks tutorial comments and add the missing ones. Comments only, no behaviour change.

comments.text: Every .nox and .nyx file outside tests/ now has tutorial comments (PRs 95 to 99 and the editor app PR). Left out on purpose: the 224 test programs under tests/ and the .chaos and .cosmos files. See the follow-up feature.
